elements.name: Align the model browser and viewport to the workspace frame

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the model browser is docked at the left
the user inspects the workspace boundaries
the model browser begins at the left content edge directly below the ribbon
the viewport begins at the browser's shared divider without an empty gutter
the viewport fills the remaining content width
the ribbon, browser, viewport and status area use aligned outer edges

elements.name: Align the document tabs with the viewport instead of the browser

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the model browser is docked at the left
the user inspects the bottom workspace rows
the browser extends to the status area above the bottom row
the document tab strip begins at the viewport's left edge
the document tab strip ends at the viewport's right edge
no document tabs appear below the model browser
the status area spans the full application width
